review.posthog_relevance: Adds a counter and test for gRPC retry behavior, potentially distinguishing transient transport errors from permanent record loss in the flags ingestion path.
review.reason: Adds a counter for successful retries and a test asserting correct failure counting, supporting reliability and diagnostics for gRPC transport handling.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit depends on the broader context of the gRPC implementation and the specific failure modes this distinguishes, which are not fully demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No cross-PR or cross-repo context is supplied, so I cannot distinguish unrelated work or establish broader systemic impact. I treat this as one conservative group. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.
